proposal.rationale: The trajectory contains durable, host-neutral project facts from direct user statements: the user is building a Web MIDI capability to recognize electronic drum kits (m_0005:0), requested a common JSON dataset format with manufacturer, model name, and possible versions starting with the top 5 Roland kits (m_0001:0, m_0003:0, m_0005:0), and then revised the format mid-conversation to also include MIDI mappings per kit (m_0007:0).
